about_the_game:
Challenge your reflexes and unlock unique abilities in this action RPG focused on fast-paced combat and clever strategy. Amid dimensions filled with dangers, build your own build and achieve victory in the Magical University Games — where the best wizards compete for the legendary Ultimate Orb!

Creative combat

Navigate dimensions from a top-down perspective that favors strategic action. With a simple click, teleport to any visible point on the screen. A core mechanic that redefines how the player moves, attacks and reacts under pressure. Positioning and reflexes are the key to victory.

Master new skills and evolve your combat style

At the end of each dimension, choose between different skills that expand your arsenal and shape new tactics. Each decision directly impacts your playstyle, allowing for unique combinations that adapt to the challenges ahead. Customize your journey and discover powerful synergies with each match.

Weapons and styles for every combat

Combine melee attacks and ranged abilities to adapt to different threats. Customize your approach with techniques that evolve as you progress, unlocking new ways to face dangers in creative or brutal ways, if you prefer.

A challenge that rewards skill

The game doesn't take it easy, each enemy and boss tests your reflexes and your decisions. But here, the difficulty is fair: learning, precision and mastery of mechanics are your greatest weapons. Dying is part of the journey, winning is always your merit.
